description: This file is a shell script for testing various Git merge and checkout error scenarios, including handling of untracked files, local changes, and directory states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success, executing the provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes the command expecting it to fail, used for negative test cases.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output against expected files to verify correctness.
